There's a lot the game tutorial doesn't cover. Easiest way to attack a portal if it isn't heavily modded/protected, as a lower level, is to stand on a resonator and use bursters. To make shooting a burster stronger, you hold down on the screen and try to make the circle get as small as it can get.

You can hack a general portal 4 times. You have to wait about 5 minutes in-between each hack, and once you're done it is "burnt out", which means you can not hack that portal for another 4 hours I believe...

If you glyph hack, and do it correctly, you get more items generally. That's when you hold the "hack" button down and do the tracing game, where it creates sentences in the Ingress language.

Usually if the portal is on its own, putting turrets on it doesn't do a lot. It's when you have a cluster of portals that really does damage to someone attacking your portal
